label: Anchored chassis
description: The fixed base supports the prepared assembly. It stays anchored during the demonstration.

label: Housing fasteners
description: Four illustrative housing screws. The dependency graph requires these to be released before the panels.

label: Left enclosure
description: Graphite side panel. Opens access to the reservoir and pump in this concept.

label: Right enclosure
description: Right panel and rear enclosure protect the internal assemblies.

label: Top & control fascia
description: The aluminium lid, front shield and upper fascia lift away together as a simplified assembly.

label: Water reservoir
description: Stores the water supply. Its translucent-blue appearance is stylized; it is not a measured capacity.

label: Pressure pump
description: The pump moves water from the reservoir towards the heating assembly. No pressure rating is claimed.

label: Heating assembly
description: Copper heating body warms the water before it reaches the brew group. Temperature is not simulated.

label: Water lines
description: Prepared copper tubing connects the conceptual components. The highlighted route explains the sequence, not fluid physics.

label: Control module
description: A representative low-voltage control board. Components and wiring are illustrative.

label: Brew group
description: Routes heated water through the coffee basket. This is an educational assembly, not service guidance.

label: Portafilter
description: The removable basket and walnut handle sit below the brew group.

label: Drip tray
description: Removable grate and tray beneath the brew area.

label: Pressure dial
description: A decorative pressure dial gives the concept a familiar interface; its needle is not a sensor reading.
